events.title: Capgemini Q3 营收 €60.7 亿（+12.6%）并年内第二次上调 2026 指引：AI 需求成为核心驱动
events.title_en: Capgemini Q3 revenue €6,073M (+12.6%), raises 2026 guidance for the second time as AI demand drives growth
events.summary: Capgemini 于 2026-10-30 发布 Q3 财报：营收 €6,073M，按现行汇率 +12.6%、固定汇率 +11.7%，订单额 +3.4%；年内第二次上调 2026 全年固定汇率增长指引至 9.0–9.5%（7 月曾上调至 8.5–9%），明确将上调归因于 AI 相关需求的强劲拉动与北美市场表现。继 7 月之后再次以财报口径验证「AI 工作正在转化为咨询收入」。
events.summary_en: On October 30, 2026, Capgemini reported Q3 revenue of €6,073M (+12.6% reported, +11.7% constant currency) with bookings up 3.4%, and raised its 2026 constant-currency growth guidance to 9.0–9.5% — the second raise this year — explicitly attributing the upgrade to surging AI-related demand and North America strength.

events.title: Deloitte 举办 2026 AI Forum：主题「AI That Means Business. ROI That Counts.」
events.title_en: Deloitte hosts 2026 AI Forum under the theme 'AI That Means Business. ROI That Counts.'
events.summary: Deloitte 于 2026-10-29 至 10-30 举办年度旗舰 AI Forum，聚集 AI 领袖与 C-suite 高管，议题覆盖 AI 用例与已实现结果、人才策略与生态伙伴合作，主题明确聚焦「算得出 ROI 的 AI」。属品牌与思想领导力活动：把 Deloitte 的 AI 叙事从能力展示进一步锚定在客户 ROI 上；论坛产出的报告与用例待后续入库。
events.summary_en: On October 29–30, 2026, Deloitte hosted its flagship AI Forum, convening AI leaders and C-suite executives around use cases, realized results, talent strategies, and ecosystem partnerships under the theme 'AI That Means Business. ROI That Counts.'
